data: What is the approximate BLEU value of the blue dashed line at 10 pre-training epochs?

The blue dashed line represents the CNN-R (Downstream acc.) metric. At approximately 10 pre-training epochs, the blue dashed line intersects with the y-axis around the 20 mark. Therefore, the approximate BLEU value of the blue dashed line at 10 pre-training epochs is 20.
